title: Migrate snapshots to Preact
body: Right now, our snapshots are still using react even we've [moved the whole code base to using preact](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/2395). Let's remove the aliasing and update all the snapshots (after checking that everything still work correctly)

comments.body: That seems quite a challenge, tooling is not as mature, lots of hacks. Let's reopen if it bites us :D
